performance.selection_policy: Latest archived forecast per race/model, captured at least five minutes before scheduled start.

CONTEXT_FORM_RESEARCH_V1.calibration_note: Runner observations within a race are dependent. Calibration bins are descriptive; uncertainty resamples whole races.

evaluation.threshold_note: 30 and 100 are research review milestones, not validation or profitability guarantees.
evaluation.comparison: Paired form-model minus equal-chance score on the same frozen field; negative values favour the form model.

model_comparison.comparison: Context minus original form baseline on identical frozen fields and observed winners; negative deltas favour context.
limitations: Different capture times and conditions may confound comparisons; freeze times are shown for each pair.
The original baseline covers all-weather flat racing only. No paired turf or jump performance is available from it.
Single-publisher provisional results may change. This is neither independent validation nor a market/odds/ROI comparison.
Parameter fingerprints separate configurations. Small samples and selective full-field coverage limit conclusions.
